name: Oswell Agusta Westland
original_name: オズウェル・アグスタ・ウエストランド
source:
A fellow mechanic.
He acts cold and apathetic to those around him.
He especially acts cold to the protagonist and doesn't recognize her as a good mechanic because she is a girl.
His rank is engineer first-class.
